name: Lattice Core
desc: A crystalline resonator grown through the hull. It hums louder the harder the ship fights, and when it peaks, the next ship system sings in Overtone.
short: A crystalline resonator grown through the hull.

name: Conductor's Bridge
desc: The Conductor's core does not just resonate, it leads: every Lattice ship near it tunes to it.
short: The Conductor's core does not just resonate, it leads: every Lattice ship near it tunes to it.
sModDesc: The bridge's reach grows to %s units.

name: Fracture
desc: The Staccato's guns leave fracture lines in whatever they hit, and enough of them make plating simply come apart.
short: The Staccato's guns leave fracture lines in whatever they hit, and enough of them make plating simply come apart.
sModDesc: Plating shatters after %s stacks instead of 5, for %s armor damage.

name: Stolen Time
desc: The Virtuoso's core feeds on the readiness of everything it wounds, and drinks deep from everything it kills.
short: The Virtuoso's core feeds on the readiness of everything it wounds, and drinks deep from everything it kills.
sModDesc: Readiness theft and kill refunds increased by %s.

name: Bravura
desc: At full readiness the Virtuoso sings at full voice: faster, hotter and nearly impossible to pin down.
short: At full readiness the Virtuoso sings at full voice: faster, hotter and nearly impossible to pin down.
sModDesc: Bravura starts at %s combat readiness and lasts until it drops below %s.

name: Unbound Core
desc: The Virtuoso's core drops its safety tuning, as Safety Overrides does for lesser hulls - without the range penalty. Only the full Virtuoso can install it.
short: The Virtuoso's core drops its safety tuning, as Safety Overrides does for lesser hulls - without the range penalty.

name: Bravura (Silent)
desc: INACTIVE. The Unsung's core cannot reach full voice until the Virtuoso is restored.

name: Concert Pitch
desc: A rare lattice augment that retunes the core to a perfect reference pitch: longer reach, longer endurance and a crystal that shrugs off EMP.
short: A rare lattice augment that retunes the core to a perfect reference pitch: longer reach, longer endurance and a crystal that shrugs off EMP.
sModDesc: A further %s range for Resonance Lattice weapons. When enhanced as a hull's own built-in (the Virtuoso), also %s maximum combat readiness and %s seconds of peak performance time.

name: Phase-Locked Petals
desc: The Cantor Array's petals share one phase: when one falls, the others take up its voice.
short: The Cantor Array's petals share one phase: when one falls, the others take up its voice.

name: Tuned Wings
desc: The Fermata's fighters are tuned to its ring and come home to it faster.
short: The Fermata's fighters are tuned to its ring and come home to it faster.
sModDesc: The tuning zone grows to %s units and fighters are replaced %s faster while in it.

name: Dead Chorus
desc: The First Chorus died at its collars two centuries ago. Its cores never stopped ringing, and when one falls silent, the others sing louder.
short: The First Chorus died at its collars two centuries ago.

name: Chorus Movement
desc: The Precentor's retuning: the Virtuoso's core learns to give as well as take.
short: The Precentor's retuning: the Virtuoso's core learns to give as well as take.

name: Solo Movement
desc: Saskia Venn's own tuning: a voice meant to sing alone, and hungrier for it.
short: Saskia Venn's own tuning: a voice meant to sing alone, and hungrier for it.
